description: Gadoon Textile Mills Limited was established in 1988 and describes itself as one of the largest spinning units in Pakistan, manufacturing and processing all types of cotton and manmade fibres at plants in Karachi and Gadoon Amazai in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. It runs spinning, knitting and dairy divisions: the spinning division produces a wide range of cotton, blended and synthetic yarns, the knitting division makes bed linen, and the dairy division produces and sells milk from a herd of over 1,300 animals. The company presents itself within the Yunus Brothers Group on its group profile page.

products.name: Spinning division — yarn
products.summary: Carded and combed cotton yarn, CVC and poly/cotton blends, fancy, melange, neppy, open-end, slub, core-spun, TFO and zero-twist yarns, in counts the company lists from NE 6/1 up to NE 160.

products.name: Knitting division — bed linen
products.summary: Knitted fitted sheets, jersey pillow covers, jersey and terry sheet sets, duvet sets and nursery sheets, in cotton, polyester and blended qualities for institutional and export customers.

products.name: Dairy division
products.summary: Production and sale of milk from a dairy farm with a herd of over 1,300 animals, with milk stored in insulated chilled tankers.
